direction.situation: Colombo roadside in continuous light rain, just after Kasun has handed back Anudi's phone; the returned phone rests low at her hip and a brief warm exchange about his stall is about to begin.
direction.people: Anudi (on screen): waist-up at frame left, cream blouse and muted teal skirt, holding her phone in her right hand and an umbrella in her left; she enters this beat grateful and receptive, then curious about Kasun's work. Kasun (on screen, right depth near his three-wheeler): present in the right background, friendly and quietly proud of his stall; he listens and offers space for her questions.

flow.text: Anudi holds the returned phone low at her right hip and keeps a small, warm smile; rain dots the umbrella at her left hand.
Her attention shifts from the polite moment to the food three-wheeler behind Kasun; her smile deepens into an interested look as her eyes travel toward the stall and then back to Kasun.

flow.how: open curiosity, warm and respectful, lifting her chin a little toward him as she asks
flow.listener: Kasun gives a small, encouraging smile and leans a fraction forward with a light nod, listening attentively

flow.text: After the question, Anudi holds her gaze on Kasun, the smile still present but waiting for his answer; rain and distant traffic continue under the overcast light.

direction.camera: MS (Anudi waist up) from road side, eye level, locked-off on a tripod; three-wheeler sits in right background.
direction.sound: light continuous rain, distant traffic, occasional three-wheeler engine; no music.
